functions.name: TryMalloc
functions.docs:
TryMalloc - like Malloc(), but may return a nullptr result if the allocation
request cannot be satisfied.

functions.name: TryRealloc
functions.docs:
TryRealloc - like Realloc(), but may return a nullptr if the allocation
request cannot be satisfied. Note that in this case the memory
pointed to by Original will still be valid

functions.name: MallocZeroed
functions.docs: Malloc zeroed memory

functions.name: TryMallocZeroed
functions.docs:
TryMalloc - like MallocZeroed(), but may return a nullptr result if the allocation
request cannot be satisfied.

functions.name: QuantizeSize
functions.docs:
For some allocators this will return the actual size that should be requested to eliminate
internal fragmentation. The return value will always be >= Count. This can be used to grow
and shrink containers to optimal sizes.
This call is always fast and threadsafe with no locking.

functions.name: GetAllocationSize
Trim
functions.docs: Releases as much memory as possible. Must be called from the main thread.

functions.name: SetupTLSCachesOnCurrentThread
functions.docs: Set up TLS caches on the current thread. These are the threads that we can trim.

functions.name: MarkTLSCachesAsUsedOnCurrentThread
functions.docs: Mark TLS caches for the current thread as used. Thread has woken up to do some processing and needs its TLS caches back.

functions.name: MarkTLSCachesAsUnusedOnCurrentThread
functions.docs: Mark TLS caches for current thread as unused. Typically before going to sleep. These are the threads that we can trim without waking them up.

functions.name: ClearAndDisableTLSCachesOnCurrentThread
functions.docs: Clears the TLS caches on the current thread and disables any future caching.

functions.name: InitializeStatsMetadata
functions.docs:
Initializes stats metadata. We need to do this as soon as possible, but cannot be done in the constructor
due to the FName::StaticInit

functions.name: Exec
functions.docs: Handles any commands passed in on the command line

functions.name: UpdateStats
functions.docs: Called once per frame, gathers and sets all memory allocator statistics into the corresponding stats. MUST BE THREAD SAFE.

functions.name: GetAllocatorStats
functions.docs: Writes allocator stats from the last update into the specified destination.

functions.name: DumpAllocatorStats
functions.docs: Dumps current allocator stats to the log.

functions.name: ValidateHeap
functions.docs: Validates the allocator's heap

functions.name: GetDescriptiveName
functions.docs:
Gets descriptive name for logging purposes.
@return pointer to human-readable malloc name

functions.name: OnMallocInitialized
functions.docs: Notifies the malloc implementation that initialization of all allocators in GMalloc is complete, so it's safe to initialize any extra features that require "regular" allocations

functions.name: OnPreFork
functions.docs: Notifies the malloc implementation that the process is about to fork. May be used to trim caches etc.

functions.name: OnPostFork
functions.docs: Notifies the malloc implementation that the process has forked so we can try and avoid dirtying pre-fork pages.

functions.name: GetImmediatelyFreeableCachedMemorySize
functions.docs: Returns the amount of free memory cached by the allocator that can be returned to the system in case of a memory shortage

functions.name: GetTotalFreeCachedMemorySize
functions.docs:
Returns the amount of total free memory cached by the allocator.
This includes memory that can be returned to the system in case of a memory shortage, see GetImmediatelyFreeableCachedMemorySize()
as well as any memory that can't be returned back to the kernel, but can be used to satisfy some of the allocation requirements.
